name: s0_continuation_mechanisms
caption: For each candidate generator, all three continuation mechanisms are attempted: raw text completion, assistant prefill, and instruction-framed chat. Records whether the model continues the text, its finish reason, the local-vs-API prompt token delta (which reveals a server-side chat template), and whether the output looks like meta-commentary rather than continuation.
